Evan: Need a quick onboarding bench for sirocco-6b before we flip any canary. Scope: smoke latency, 1-minute steady throughput, and a tail-latency sweep up to p999. Run both fp16 and q4_0 (q4f16 if q4_0 misbehaves). Use tokenizer: llama-tokenizer-v2. Hardware: start on A100-80GB. For steady runs use 2 GPUs. Please post raw artifacts to s3 and a short summary here.
Maia: Copy. Do you have a preferred prompt set? short convo vs code-heavy?
Evan: Mix of both. Sophie, do we have a 60-prompt combo set?
Sophie: Uploaded combo set: <https://internal.s3/bench-prompts/sirocco_combo60.json> 
Jun: Picking this up. Will kick off q4_0 first on a100-80 x1 for smoke, then fp16 if needed. Enabling KV-cache warmup + dynamic batching.
perf-bot: job 2174321989 started by Jun — bench (sirocco-6b, q4_0) on a100-80x1
Jun: Quick smoke results (q4_0, a100-80 x1, 1k seq):
```
median: 33ms
p95: 98ms
p99: 140ms
p999: 320ms
tokens/sec: 4800
gpu_mem_peak: 14.7GB
GPU_util_avg: 72%
```
Sophie: p999 is a bit high. Any kernel hot spots?
Jun: Profiling shows self-attention kernels dominating and occasional CUDA syncs on long prompts. KV hit rate ~0.995. snippet: ```attn_kernel: 78%
memcpy: 4%
sync_wait: 7%```
Maia: Can you try lowering block size in quant config (from 256 to 128) and re-run q4_0? Might reduce sync stalls.
Jun: Will do a quick block-size sweep and then run a 2-GPU steady (512 seq, B=8) after. ETA ~1h.
perf-bot: job 2174321990 completed — smoke q4_0. artifacts: s3://redwood/bench/2174321989
Jun: Results after block-size tweak + fp16 run and steady 2-GPU sweep: summary below. Full artifacts: s3://redwood/bench/2174321991
- q4_0, block=128, a100-80 x1 smoke: median 30ms, p95 85ms, p99 130ms, p999 260ms, tokens/sec 5200, gpu_mem 15.1GB
- fp16, a100-80 x1 smoke: median 28ms, p95 78ms, p99 120ms, p999 200ms, tokens/sec 5600, gpu_mem 22.4GB
- steady (fp16), a100-80 x2, 512 seq, dynamic batch up to 16: throughput 34k tokens/sec, p95 90ms, p99 150ms, p999 310ms, mem/GPU ~11.2GB
Maia: Nice. fp16 gives a consistent tail improvement but higher memory. For canary we should weigh cost vs p95 target. Evan, what p95 threshold do we want?
Evan: Keep p95 <= 120ms for canary. If q4_0 meets that with fallback on fp16, we can route 5% traffic. Also add automatic fallback to aurora7b if p95>200ms.
Jun: I'll draft a canary config: 5% traffic q4_0, 20% fallback to fp16 on high tail, fallback to aurora7b at p95>200ms. I'll open bench PR with artifacts + flamegraphs + kernel timings.
Sophie: Heads up — saw tokenizer edge-case where code blocks with leading tabs inflated token counts. I have a small tokenizer patch queued (PR link once ready).
perf-bot: job 2174322500 started — long tail sweep (sirocco-6b, fp16) on a100-80x2
Jun: Long tail sweep results (fp16, a100-80 x2, 2h run, mixed prompts): p999 290ms, p995 170ms, p99 145ms. No OOMs. Flamegraphs attached in artifacts.
Evan: Good work. Action list: [1] Jun: open bench PR + perf notes and canary YAML, include fallback rules. [2] Maia: schedule canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC and prep traffic routing. [3] Sophie: finalize tokenizer fix and link in PR. [4] Infra: monitor GPU saturation during canary and alert on p95 regression.
Maia: I'll take 2 and add SLO guardrails.
Jun: Opening PRs now. PRs will reference artifacts s3://redwood/bench/2174321991 and s3://redwood/bench/2174322501.
Evan: Thanks team. Marking resolved once PRs merged and canary YAML committed. :white_check_mark:
